# "omnivoice" venv: the interpreter behind the OmniVoice voice engine
# (sidecar/omnivoice_server.py, a small FastAPI app like sidecar/server.py).
#
# A venv of its own, not the engines one: omnivoice pins transformers>=5.3,
# and the engines venv's qwen-tts pins transformers==4.57.3 -- the two cannot
# share one environment.
#
# omnivoice is the official k2-fsa package (Apache-2.0). Its weights are a
# separate download under their own non-commercial license, fetched by the
# app's model catalog into models/omnivoice, never by this list.
#
# torch/torchaudio: pip auto-selects the Apple Silicon (arm64, MPS-capable)
# wheel for these version numbers on macOS -- do not add a CUDA index-url.
torch==2.8.0
torchaudio==2.8.0

omnivoice==0.2.1
fastapi
uvicorn[standard]
python-multipart
soundfile==0.14.0
numpy==2.4.6
